speaker_role: former admissions officer (University of Chicago), now senior strategist at Crimson Education
commercial_incentive: Crimson sells admissions consulting; video ends with a pitch for a free consultation.
key_insights: Start the personal statement by choosing a story showing personal growth, which signals capacity to keep growing in college.
Show rather than assert claims about yourself by depicting the moment they occurred.
Do not spend the essay on another extracurricular or on someone else; essays about parents or grandparents are common, but the applicant is the one being admitted.
Readiness test: remove your name, drop the essay at school, and your best friend should be able to identify the author.
An essay anyone could have written is not specific enough to be memorable.
notable_or_distinctive: Frames the statement as demonstrating growth and gives the name-removed best-friend test.
reliability_notes: Brief and generic with a sales pitch; the FAO credential is self-stated in the promotional video.
